name: Solana Hexapod Walker
description: Six-legged walking robot for complex terrain navigation and inspection

workflow.name: Initialize Scene
workflow.prompt:
Set up scene for hexapod robot:

1. Clear all default objects
2. Set Metric units, scale 1.0
3. Create collections: 'Body', 'Legs', 'Sensors', 'Environment'
4. Ground plane 4m x 4m
5. Add terrain variation:
   - Subdivide ground
   - Add slight displacement for uneven surface
6. Three-point lighting with fill
7. Camera at (0.8, -0.8, 0.5) looking at origin
8. Set render to Cycles

workflow.name: Create Hexagonal Body
workflow.prompt:
Create the hexapod main body:

1. Create hexagonal prism:
   - Use cylinder with 6 vertices
   - Radius 0.12m, height 0.04m
   - Position at (0, 0, 0.12)

2. Shape the body:
   - Flatten top and bottom
   - Bevel edges for aerodynamic look
   - Slight dome on top

3. Create leg mounting sockets:
   - 6 cylindrical recesses at each vertex
   - Radius 0.015m, depth 0.01m
   - Angle outward 15° from vertical

4. Create internal structure:
   - Rib supports visible through vents
   - Central electronics bay

5. Add ventilation:
   - Hexagonal pattern vents on top
   - Side ventilation slots

6. Create sensor dome:
   - Small dome at body center top
   - Transparent cover
   - Houses camera and sensors

7. Apply material:
   - 'mat_carbon_fiber' - Dark with weave pattern
   - Color RGB(0.05, 0.05, 0.08)

8. Name: 'hexapod_body'
9. Add to 'Body' collection

workflow.name: Create Leg Template
workflow.prompt:
Create a template leg with 3-DOF (coxa-femur-tibia):

Coxa Joint (hip rotation):
1. Servo housing:
   - Cube 0.025m x 0.02m x 0.018m
   - Mounts to body socket
   - Rotates leg forward/backward

Femur Segment (upper leg):
1. Servo housing for femur joint:
   - Perpendicular to coxa
   - Raises/lowers leg
2. Femur link:
   - Tapered tube: 0.06m length
   - Start diameter 0.012m, end 0.008m
   - Carbon fiber material

Tibia Segment (lower leg):
1. Servo housing for tibia joint:
   - At end of femur
   - Extends/retracts lower leg
2. Tibia link:
   - Tapered tube: 0.07m length
   - Curved slightly for ground contact
   - Pointed tip with rubber pad

Foot:
1. Rubber foot pad:
   - Sphere radius 0.008m
   - High-grip rubber material
   - Slight compliance

Apply materials:
- Servos: 'mat_servo_black'
- Links: 'mat_carbon_fiber'
- Foot: 'mat_rubber_grip' - Color RGB(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)

Name: 'hexapod_leg_template'
Set origins at each joint for animation

workflow.name: Duplicate and Position Legs
workflow.prompt:
Create all six legs from template:

Leg positions (60° apart around hexagon):

1. Front Right (FR) - Position 30°:
   - Duplicate leg template
   - Position at body vertex
   - Rotate coxa 30° from forward
   - Name: 'hexapod_leg_FR'

2. Front Left (FL) - Position 150°:
   - Mirror of FR
   - Name: 'hexapod_leg_FL'

3. Middle Right (MR) - Position -30°:
   - Perpendicular to body
   - Name: 'hexapod_leg_MR'

4. Middle Left (ML) - Position -150°:
   - Mirror of MR
   - Name: 'hexapod_leg_ML'

5. Rear Right (RR) - Position -90°:
   - Angled backward
   - Name: 'hexapod_leg_RR'

6. Rear Left (RL) - Position 90°:
   - Mirror of RR
   - Name: 'hexapod_leg_RL'

For each leg:
- Parent coxa servo to body
- Parent femur to coxa
- Parent tibia to femur
- Parent foot to tibia

Set neutral standing pose:
- Femur angled 45° down
- Tibia angled 90° from femur
- Feet touching ground

workflow.name: Create Head Sensor Array
workflow.prompt:
Create the front sensor head:

1. Camera turret:
   - Pan-tilt mechanism
   - Two servos for 2-DOF
   - Position at front of body

2. Main camera:
   - Wide-angle RGB camera
   - 0.02m x 0.02m housing
   - Visible lens

3. Depth sensor:
   - Small stereo camera pair
   - IR projector between them

4. LED illuminators:
   - Two small LEDs flanking camera
   - For low-light operation

5. Create protective cover:
   - Clear dome over sensors
   - Scratch-resistant appearance

6. Add antenna:
   - Small whip antenna
   - For telemetry

7. Apply materials:
   - Housing: match body material
   - Lens: 'mat_glass_dark'
   - LEDs: 'mat_led_white' with emission

8. Name: 'hexapod_head'
9. Parent to body with ability to pan/tilt

workflow.name: Create IMU and Internal Sensors
workflow.prompt:
Add internal sensor modules:

1. IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit):
   - Small PCB at body center
   - 0.025m x 0.025m x 0.003m
   - Accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer

2. Current sensors:
   - On each leg servo
   - Monitor torque/force

3. Joint encoders:
   - Position feedback on each joint
   - Small discs on servo output

4. Battery monitor:
   - Voltage and current sensing
   - Temperature monitoring

5. Foot pressure sensors:
   - Force-sensitive resistor in each foot
   - Ground contact detection

6. Add internal wiring:
   - Cable harness from body to legs
   - Spiral wrap for flexibility
   - Connector at each coxa joint

7. Apply PCB materials to sensor boards
8. Keep sensors mostly internal/hidden

workflow.name: Create Electronics Stack
workflow.prompt:
Create the main electronics:

1. Raspberry Pi 5:
   - Central processor
   - Position in body center
   - 0.085m x 0.056m

2. Servo controller board:
   - 18-channel servo controller
   - Position below Pi
   - Stacked configuration

3. Power distribution:
   - Main power board
   - Voltage regulators
   - 5V for Pi, 7.4V for servos

4. Battery pack:
   - 2S or 3S LiPo
   - Compact form factor
   - 0.06m x 0.04m x 0.02m
   - Fits in body cavity

5. WiFi module:
   - Integrated or USB dongle
   - Antenna routing

6. Create mounting:
   - Standoffs and screws
   - Vibration dampening

7. Add status LEDs:
   - Power indicator
   - Activity lights
   - Error indicator

8. Materials: PCB green, component colors
9. Parent all to body

workflow.name: Create LED Status Ring
workflow.prompt:
Add status indication LEDs:

1. Body perimeter LEDs:
   - Ring of 12 RGB LEDs
   - Around body edge
   - Individually addressable

2. Create diffuser strip:
   - Translucent material over LEDs
   - Smooth light appearance

3. Leg status LEDs:
   - One LED per leg at coxa
   - Shows leg state (stance/swing)

4. Head status:
   - LED ring around camera
   - Shows attention/direction

5. Create animation-ready setup:
   - Each LED as separate emission material
   - Can be animated for patterns

6. Default colors:
   - Idle: slow cyan breathing
   - Walking: rotating blue pattern
   - Error: red flash

7. Apply emission materials:
   - Strength 3.0 for visibility
   - Various colors available

8. Name: 'hexapod_led_*' for each

workflow.name: Add Shell Cover
workflow.prompt:
Create optional protective shell:

1. Top shell:
   - Follows body contour
   - Slight gap for ventilation
   - Hexagonal shape matching body

2. Design features:
   - Aerodynamic curves
   - Raised center ridge
   - Cutouts for sensors

3. Add details:
   - Panel lines
   - Ventilation slots at rear
   - Access hatch

4. Create transparent section:
   - Over sensor dome
   - Clear polycarbonate look

5. Add grip texture:
   - For carrying handle area
   - Rubberized zones

6. Apply materials:
   - Main shell: 'mat_shell_black' - Matte finish
   - Accents: 'mat_accent_cyan' - Solana colors

7. Name: 'hexapod_shell'
8. Parent to body (can be hidden)

workflow.name: Create Walking Pose
workflow.prompt:
Set up a natural walking pose:

1. Tripod gait stance:
   - Three legs in stance (FR, ML, RR)
   - Three legs in swing (FL, MR, RL)

2. Stance legs:
   - Feet firmly on ground
   - Body supported evenly
   - Slight bend in all joints

3. Swing legs:
   - Lifted 0.03m off ground
   - Mid-swing position
   - Ready to step forward

4. Body attitude:
   - Level with ground
   - Or slight forward tilt for forward motion

5. Head position:
   - Looking forward
   - Slightly down for path scanning

6. Save pose:
   - Create pose library entry
   - Name: 'walk_tripod_1'

7. Alternative pose:
   - Swap stance/swing legs
   - Name: 'walk_tripod_2'

8. Verify ground contact and stability

workflow.name: Add Branding
workflow.prompt:
Apply Solana branding and details:

1. Solana logo:
   - On top shell/body
   - Gradient purple-cyan
   - Size: 0.04m diameter

2. Model designation:
   - 'HEX-6' on side
   - Clean sans-serif font

3. Serial/ID plate:
   - Small metal plate
   - QR code for identification

4. Warning labels:
   - 'CAUTION: MOVING PARTS'
   - Near leg bases

5. Version info:
   - 'v1.0 SOLANA ROBOTICS'
   - Small text on bottom

6. Add reflective elements:
   - Small reflectors on legs
   - For visibility

7. Final organization:
   - Group all leg parts
   - Verify parenting
   - Check all materials

8. Save as 'solana_hexapod.blend'
